premises.text: Traffic navigation apps are not as smart as they could be due to pre-computed routes and assumptions about traffic.
premises.evidence_span: apps you use aren't nearly as smart as you think. Let's say we're going from downtown LA to Santa Monica. Where does that route actually come from? There are literally billions of possible routes, even for that short drive.

premises.text: Accurate traffic data sources like loop detectors and traffic cameras can improve navigation.
premises.evidence_span: there are much more accurate sources of traffic data besides phones, like loop detectors and traffic cameras, and soon, advanced vehicles.

premises.text: TallyGo provides time-dependent routing based on real-time traffic data.
premises.evidence_span: we built the first-ever intelligent routing layer for minute-level data.

premises.text: Businesses that depend on navigation currently face poor options for integrating real-time navigation.
premises.evidence_span: any company that needs navigation is faced with three really poor options.

premises.text: TallyGo's SDK allows companies to embed real-time navigation directly into their apps.
premises.evidence_span: With TallyGo's navigation SDK, for the very first time, any company can embed real-time, turn-by-turn navigation directly into their existing apps.

value.text: Navigation can be embedded seamlessly into existing applications, improving efficiency for businesses.
value.evidence_span: we believe that navigation is the next revolution in SaaS and that very soon it will be embedded everywhere.

notes: No separate premises for the demo and integration steps as they are part of the same offering.
